answer: Challenge-Bound Identity Minting. Each agent identity must embed a fresh, verifier-signed challenge derived from the prior block's state, so any replay fails validation and collapses duplicate submissions. The challenge acts as a sparrow: small, single-use, and impossible to clone without the signer's key. A mirror check compares submitted proofs across the ledger, rejecting near-identical fingerprints. To pass, an attacker must bridge the signer's live state each round, paying a fresh signature and unique proof per identity,
